title: RA-CoA: Training-free Fashion Image Captioning via Retrieval-Augmented Chain-of-Attributes
abstract: arXiv:2609.14100v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fashion Image Captioning (FIC) plays a vital role in enhancing user experience and product search in e-commerce platforms. Unlike natural scene image captioning, FIC requires fine-grained visual reasoning and knowledge of domain-specific terminology to capture subtle attributes such as neckline and closure types, graphic patterns, and dress silhouettes. Moreover, as fashion inventories evolve rapidly with new trends, styles, and frequently emerging vocabulary, developing training-free captioning solution becomes essential for scalability and real-world adaptability. Instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising solution to fashion image captioning dueto their strong zero-shot capabilities and natural language fluency. However, these general-purpose models often lack attribute-level coverage and precision, and tend to hallucinate or misidentify fine-grained fashion details, making them less suitable for high-fidelity

translated_title: RA-CoA：基于检索增强属性链的无训练时尚图像描述生成
translated_abstract: 时尚图像描述在提升电商平台用户体验和商品搜索方面发挥着至关重要的作用。与自然场景图像描述不同，时尚图像描述需要细粒度的视觉推理和领域专业术语知识，以捕捉诸如领口与闭合类型、图案以及服装廓形等细微属性。此外，随着时尚库存随新趋势、新款式和新词汇的频繁涌现而快速演变，开发免训练的描述生成解决方案对于可扩展性和现实世界的适应性变得至关重要。经过指令微调的视觉语言模型（VLM）凭借其强大的零样本能力和流畅的自然语言表达，为时尚图像描述提供了一种有前景的解决方案。然而，这些通用模型通常缺乏属性级别的覆盖范围和精确度，容易产生幻觉或错误识别细粒度的时尚细节，使其不太适合高保真……
tldr: 该论文提出RA-CoA方法，通过检索增强的属性链推理机制，在无需训练的情况下引导视觉语言模型捕捉细粒度时尚属性，从而提升属性覆盖度与描述精确度并减少幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RA-CoA, a training-free fashion image captioning method that leverages retrieval-augmented chain-of-attributes reasoning to guide vision-language models in capturing fine-grained fashion attributes, improving attribute coverage and precision while reducing hallucinations.
